nphi.title: SECID – South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases
nphi.actor: SECID / Institute of Public Health, Albania (SEEHN)
nphi.with: South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases (Tirana); South-eastern Europe Health Network (SEEHN); national public health institutes of the region; CORDS network; assisted by US CDC
nphi.summary: Regional centre set up in Tirana in 2013 under SEEHN, linked to Albania's Institute of Public Health, that supports national authorities across South-East Europe on influenza and respiratory-pathogen surveillance, pandemic preparedness…

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: EpiSouth Mediterranean/Balkan communicable disease network
nphi.with: Institutes leading work packages in France, Bulgaria and Greece; Spanish national public health institute (training); Padua Teaching Hospital; 26 member countries in total across southern Europe, the Balkans, North Africa and the Middle East (not all named in the article)
nphi.summary: An ISS-coordinated network linking public health institutes and ministries around the Mediterranean and in the Balkans. Its work covered cross-border epidemic intelligence, vaccine-preventable diseases and migrants, emerging zoonoses, and…
